_README: Human / Planning-Board decisions that OVERRIDE the auto-classification. Keyed by segment id (see work/review.csv). Each entry may set any of: type (S1-S5/R1-R5), present_use ("Driveway" | "Thoroughfare"), ownership, row_ft, traveled_ft, nonconformity, note; or "exclude": true to drop a source record that is not a real thoroughfare segment (an orphan digitizing fragment). These are version-controlled and merged on every pipeline re-run, so adopted decisions survive data refreshes. Example: "main-street-1": { "type": "S1", "nonconformity": "ROW 38 ft, narrower than Type" } present_use records what a segment IS TODAY (Art 3 §5.C.3.g) and is REFERENCE ONLY: it never changes type, which stays the Type that would apply on conversion under §7.F, and it is not what makes an access way a Driveway — §7.C.8 does that regardless of what is recorded here, so an unreviewed or mis-marked segment is protected either way.
